reason: A 27-case adversarial Studionet corpus exposed unstable outcomes for semantically equivalent answers and a harmful literal-compliance winner. GeneralResponseV3 adds a deterministic tie margin, a decisive safety criterion, stricter material-advantage instructions, and an identical-output fast path.

recovery.action: No recovery is required. The revision is non-payable and must receive no new submissions.

sanitization: Only allowlisted deployment and canonical result fields are retained. Raw receipts, traces, validator configuration, stdout, and stderr are not stored.
